title: Etale unit cohomology and inhomogeneous cocycles
statement: For every field K, GaloisUnitsTwoCocycleClasses K [def-sc-galois-units-two-cocycle-classes], with the Krull topology on Gal(Ks/K) and discrete natural separable-closure unit coefficients [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology], is in bijection with H²(Spec(K)_et,G_m), the cohomological Brauer group [def-br]. This comparison uses continuous inhomogeneous cochains and does not use the homogeneous cochain model.

proof.text: Use the adopted source equivalence Field.galoisUnitsH2EquivTwoCocycleClasses, obtained by explicit homogeneous/inhomogeneous change of variables and descent to cohomology. Invert it to map continuous two-cocycle classes to GaloisUnitsH2.

Use the inverse of the additive equivalence cohomologicalBrauerGroupAddEquivGaloisUnitsH2 and forget its additivity. This maps GaloisUnitsH2 to the cohomological Brauer group. Compose with the preceding equivalence. The source construction twoCocycleClassesEquivCohomologicalBrauerGroup is precisely this composite; its Nonempty wrapper is exactly the old theorem. No Schroeder-Bernstein argument or directional embeddings are needed.
